_about: DK abbreviations filled on the site (John's ruling, 2026-09-29): where DK, inside a source passage, prints a quotation as 'FIRST ... LAST' and gives the full text elsewhere, the reader shows the words between. Only the cases the 2026-09-29 survey marked CERTAIN. No Greek here: each entry locates the '...' (source line n + role, char offset `at`, `left`/`right` printed words) and the full text (target line n `from`/`to`, word index `after`/`before` of the words the fill lies strictly between). `survey` is the case number in that survey. Read by pipeline/reader_pipeline/stage1_dk_fills.py.
